items.title: Henry Russ Interview, 1972-01-18
items.q: He was the first man. I was the second man.

ctx.x: Oh, I see. He was the first man. I was the second man. So I couldn't play any first.
So Steltham would be playing solo?
No, he wasn't a solo man. I was a solo man. Oh, yeah? Yeah. I was the first man since 19, I'd say 1939, I'm done. 1942. September 5, 1942. My down the Navy.
